excerpt.zh:
虚境之中，一道单一灵能形成的图腾光束越过我们直插无可计量的虚空。其构造独特而稳定，与以往司空见惯的混沌之形截然不同。

逗留于此不知是否安全？
excerpt.en:
A totemic beam of singular psionic energy extends beyond us within the Shroud into incalculable infinities. Its uniquely stable composition is a stark contrast to the usually chaotic formations we have previously encountered.

Is it safe to remain here?

tooltips.en:

If successful... well... truly, who knows?

tooltips.zh: 离开虚境，返回普通空间。
tooltips.en: Leave the Shroud and return to normal space.

texts.zh:
完美成型的灵能能量束耀眼刺目，但我们还是尽全力将注意力聚焦其上。终于，我们看清了它错综复杂、超凡脱俗的结构的真相。

我们的脑海中奔腾着新的可能性；将这种独特的能量形式在物质世界复现，我们就会得到一种无可抵挡的武器。
texts.en:
Despite its blinding intensity, we managed to hold our focus on the perfectly formed beam of psychic energy. Finally, we beheld the true nature of its intricate and otherworldly structure.

Our minds raced with new possibilities; reproducing this unique energy formation in the physical realm will grant us an unstoppable weapon.

texts.zh:
我们无法留存。靠近如此高强度的灵能能量构造使我们的[GetTelepathPlural]不堪重负。

接触这种压倒性的现象对我们心智的损伤需要一段时间才能恢复。
texts.en:
We were unable to remain. Proximity to such an intense formation of psionic energy proved to be too much for our [GetTelepathPlural].

The damage to our minds from exposure to this overwhelming phenomenon will take time to recover from.
